C0810.title: 3CX Software Supply Chain Attack
C0810.summary: In March 2023, globally recognized communication software provider 3CX suffered a cyberattack with characteristics highly similar to the 2020 SolarWinds supply chain attack. Attackers compromised 3CX's software supply chain to distribute malware to its customers, impacting a large number of downstream users.
